what: The Robust Pipeline for Disordered Structures
title: Advanced Workflow: High-Throughput Analysis of Clathrate Structures
text: Clathrate structures often feature site-occupancy disorder guest atoms within host framework. naive distance calculation can lead non-physical “ghost” distances. handle , implement specific, multi-step filtering pipeline crystal: Filter Guests: Isolate host framework removing guest atoms. Filter Ghosts: Remove physically implausible distances using filter_ghost_distances(). Identify Bonds: Determine true bonded pairs cleaned data using minimum_distance(). Calculate Average: Compute final calculate_weighted_average_network_distance() confirmed, physical bonds. Guests -> Ghosts -> Bonds -> Average sequence ensures final metric accurate physically meaningful.

Filter Guest Atoms     distances <- filter_by_elements(distances, coords, guest_atoms)     if (nrow(distances) == 0) return(NULL)          # 2. Filter Ghost Distances     ghost_filter_result <- filter_ghost_distances(distances, coords, margin = 0.1)     cleaned_distances <- ghost_filter_result$kept          removed_table <- ghost_filter_result$removed     if (nrow(removed_table) > 0) {       removed_table[, file := current_filename]       all_removed_ghosts[[length(all_removed_ghosts) + 1]] <<- removed_table     }     if (nrow(cleaned_distances) == 0) return(NULL)          # 3. Identify Bonds     bonded_pairs <- minimum_distance(cleaned_distances, delta = 0.1)     if (nrow(bonded_pairs) == 0) return(NULL)          # 4. Calculate Weighted Average     weighted_avg <- calculate_weighted_average_network_distance(bonded_pairs, coords, target_wyckoff_symbols)     if (is.na(weighted_avg)) return(NULL)          return(       data.table(         file = current_filename,         category = category,         lattice_parameter_a = analysis_results$unit_cell_metrics[[i]]$`_cell_length_a`,         weighted_distance = weighted_avg       )     )   }      plot_data_list <- lapply(1:nrow(analysis_results), process_file_results)   plot_data <- rbindlist(plot_data_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)   plot_data <- na.omit(plot_data)   removed_ghosts_summary <- rbindlist(all_removed_ghosts, fill = TRUE) }) # --- Timing End ---  cat("Data processing complete.

title: Crystallographic Information File (CIF) Data Processing Tools
text: Efficient CIF Parsing: Utilizes data.table fast robust extraction metadata, unit cell parameters, atomic coordinates, symmetry operations. Symmetry Supercell Generation: Applies symmetry operations generate full unit cell asymmetric unit expands coordinates 3x3x3 supercell neighbor searching. Geometric Calculations: Computes interatomic distances using metric tensor (correct crystal systems) calculates bond angles. Multiple Bonding Algorithms: Implements several algorithms identify bonded atoms, including minimum_distance (default), brunner, hoppe methods. Rigorous Error Propagation: Calculates propagates experimental uncertainties CIF file final calculated bond lengths angles. Powerful Post-Processing Tools: Includes functions filter results chemical element, Wyckoff site, remove non-physical “ghost” distances caused site disorder using customizable atomic radii table. Batch Processing & Export: main analyze_cif_files() function designed process hundreds files single run, results can easily exported structured directory CSV files export_analysis_to_csv().
